title: Inspect a completed review in Companion
description: Use an existing completed review request and its team. Set REVIEW_REQUEST_ID and GW_URL. Start with Show history off.

open.cmd: if [ "$PLATFORM" = ios ]; then xcrun simctl openurl "$IOS_SIMULATOR" farmslot-development:///pr-automation; else adb -s "$ANDROID_SERIAL" shell am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d farmslot-development:///pr-automation net.siteed.farmslot.development; fi
open.intent: The operator can inspect source coverage from PR automation on the selected device.

ready.intent: The connected screen exposes shared rule controls.

rules.intent: Completed review history is accessible independently of active work.

filter.intent: The operator can isolate one team's source progress.

search.intent: The selected validation team can be found in the saved inventory.

keyboard.intent: The filtered team selection remains reachable after completing the search.

choose.intent: Only the selected team's rule controls are displayed.

capture.intent: The screenshot records the actual completed round and reviewed commit.

history.intent: Completed review rounds remain available in the selected team history.

scroll.intent: The completed request and recorded commit remain readable below its original submission.

result.intent: The actual reviewed commit is displayed with the terminal request status.

verify.intent: Gateway evidence ties the completed request to the preserved worker report and original commit.
